description:
The Property
NO ONWARD CHAIN

A Stunning & Spacious Three-Bedroom First-Floor Apartment in a Superb Cardiff Bay Location with Designated Parking

Occupying a fantastic position within the popular Halliard Court development, this impressive three-bedroom first-floor apartment offers spacious and versatile accommodation in one of Cardiff's most convenient locations.

Perfectly placed between the attractions of Cardiff Bay and the city centre, the property provides an excellent opportunity for professionals, couples, families or those looking for a stylish city base with everything Cardiff has to offer within easy reach.

Step inside and a welcoming entrance hallway provides access to the accommodation. The generously proportioned sitting room creates a wonderful space in which to relax and entertain, while the separate kitchen offers a practical alternative to the open-plan layouts commonly found in modern apartments.

A particular advantage of this property is the provision of three bedrooms, offering considerably more flexibility than many apartments in the area. The additional rooms are ideal for family, visiting guests or those looking to create a dedicated home office or study.

Completing the accommodation is the family bathroom, while externally the apartment benefits from the considerable advantage of designated parking – a particularly desirable feature in such a convenient city location. 

Location is undoubtedly one of the major attractions of this home. Halliard Court is ideally positioned for buyers wanting to enjoy both the vibrant waterfront lifestyle of Cardiff Bay and the shopping, dining, entertainment and employment opportunities available within Cardiff city centre.

Cardiff Bay offers an excellent choice of waterside restaurants, cafés, bars and leisure facilities, together with some of the capital's best-known attractions, including Mermaid Quay, the Wales Millennium Centre and the beautiful waterfront around Roald Dahl Plass.

The city centre is also readily accessible, providing an extensive selection of shops, restaurants and entertainment venues together with Cardiff's major commercial and business districts.

For commuters, the location provides convenient access to the city's principal road network, with good connections towards the A4232 and M4 motorway, making travel throughout Cardiff and further afield straightforward. Public transport links are also readily available, providing convenient connections around the city and surrounding areas.

Combining three-bedroom accommodation, generous living space, a separate kitchen, designated parking and an enviable position between Cardiff Bay and the city centre, 49 Halliard Court offers an exciting opportunity to enjoy convenient city living without compromising on space.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate both the accommodation and superb location this impressive apartment has to offer.
